nodes.label: i
nodes.title: The Question Paper will have 75 questions.

nodes.label: ii
nodes.title: All questions will be based on Subject-Specific Knowledge.
GENERAL AWARENESS ABOUT CRIME, LAW AND SOCIAL ISSUES.
High Profile or Sensational Criminal Cases in Past and Present Scenario
nodes.body: Murder, Rape, Child Abuse, Human Trafficking, Corruption, Scams, Cyber Crime, Terrorism, etc.

nodes.title: Structure and Functions of Indian Criminal Justice System
nodes.body: Police/Law Enforcement, Judiciary and Prisons/Correctional System.

nodes.title: Basic Knowledge about Indian Laws
nodes.body: IPC, Cr PC and Special and Local Laws - For Examples (but not limited to), Offence against Human Body, Offence against Property, Offences against Women and Children, Offences against State, etc. FIR, Arrest and Bail Procedures in Cr PC; Basic Awareness of Juvenile Justice Act, POCSO Act, Protection of Women fromDomestic Violence Act 2005, Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act, 2013, etc.

nodes.title: Basic Understanding of Forensic Science in Criminal Investigation.
Social Issues
nodes.body: Violence against Women and Children – Child Labour, Child Marriage, Dowry, Domestic Violence, Sexual Violence, Acid Attack, Caste and Communal Conflicts; Juvenile Delinquency and Youth Violence, Drug Addiction, Human Rights Violations.
